tips.text: Back away after popping a pipe; he never freezes while anyone, companions included, stands in his face.
Bring no Cold or Heat damage; Cold lengthens his invulnerability and Heat thaws him early.
Run Kril solo; public squads that crowd him stall phase 1.
Restart the mission if he goes several cycles without freezing; the next run is usually normal.
Leave Proboscis Cernos and Harrow's Condemn at home; they can leave his pipes unshootable or lock him in an animation loop.
Bring an area weapon like Staticor that pops a tube with any hit near his upper back.
If backing away does not trigger the slam, close in so he swings the hammer.
Take Excalibur in Circuit week 1 as a backup if Systems will not drop; tier 8 gives it outright.
Expect a short farm that varies only on the Systems blueprint; most players finish in under an hour.
